leftEvidence.title: Evil seed is said to grow from Adam’s heart

points.label: Images of transmission
points.left: The dialogue uses seed, harvest, fruit, and threshing to describe wickedness sown in Adam’s heart and multiplied through time.
points.right: Paul repeatedly sets one trespass, condemnation, death, and disobedience beside the gift, righteousness, obedience, grace, and life through Jesus Christ.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Adam in 2 Esdras · later memory · 2 Esdras 4:28–32
points.right: Adam, Christ, and embodied life · later memory · Romans 5:15–21

payload.posture: 2 Esdras pictures evil as seed in Adam’s heart; Romans contrasts one trespass with one righteous act.

rightEvidence.title: Adam’s trespass is set beside Christ’s gift

payload.tension: Seed imagery and representative action describe broad consequences without using the same mechanism.
payload.title: Evil seed and one trespass
